exposure: Gestational age at surgery (all, first trimester, third trimester)
Open appendectomy or cholecystectomy during pregnancy
Laparoscopic appendectomy or cholecystectomy during pregnancy
cohort: 2941 pregnant women in Korea who underwent appendectomy or cholecystectomy during pregnancy between 2009 and 2019.
finding: Laparoscopic appendectomy or cholecystectomy during pregnancy was associated with a shorter length of stay, fewer transfusions, and similar rates of other surgical outcomes compared to the open approach.
mod_finding: Open procedures were associated with an increased rate of cesarean sections.
